Shawn Gardini, the mind behind 'Matt and Shane's Secret Podcast,' is hitting The Gordy, Houston. Known for his sharp humor and unfiltered style, Shawn's live shows are a true Philadelphia experience. From his appearances on 'Kill Tony' to 'Gilly and Keeves,' he's got the chops. If you're into stand-up with a mischievous twist, this is your night.

Catch Isabel Hagen on her TV special, "Isabel Hagen at the Bitter End." Houston, you don't want to miss this. Isabel’s deadpan humor and viola performances create a show like no other. She's from NYC and brings her Juilliard-trained talent to stand-up, blending existential jokes with notes of classical music. Her unique style and sharp wit make every moment memorable.
